source: Directive tables of the Bareos 25.1.2 Director as carried by odir (crates/odir/src/commands/show_items.rs) plus Onesimus extensions (crates/odir/src/config_check.rs EXTENSIONS)
description: A Schedule resource holds Run directives that say when the jobs that use it start, at which level and with which overrides.

examples.title: Monthly Full, weekly Differential, daily Incremental
examples.config:
Schedule {
  Name = WeeklyCycle
  Description = "Full on the first Sunday, differential on the other Sundays, incremental daily"
  Run = Full 1st sun at 23:05
  Run = Differential 2nd-5th sun at 23:05
  Run = Incremental mon-sat at 23:05
}

examples.title: Overrides per run

directives.name: Name
directives.description: Name of the schedule; jobs refer to it with Schedule.

directives.name: Description
directives.description: Free text describing the schedule. The Onesimus GUI shows and edits it in the grid editor.

examples.console: configure update schedule=WeeklyCycle description="Full on the first Sunday, incrementals daily"

directives.name: Run
directives.description: When the jobs of this schedule run, one directive per rule: optional level and overrides, then the date and time specification. See the Run block for the syntax. The Onesimus Director checks Run lines like the C++ Director and refuses an invalid one before writing it.

examples.console: configure update schedule=WeeklyCycle run="Full 1st sun at 23:05"

directives.name: Enabled
directives.description: A disabled schedule starts no job; enable schedule and disable schedule change it at run time.

blocks.name: Run
blocks.description: Syntax of a Run directive: [level] [overrides] [date specification] [at HH:MM]. The parts of the date specification combine: "1st sun" is the first Sunday, "mon-fri" every working day, "on 1 jan" the first of January. Without a date specification the run is daily. Words are case-insensitive; # starts a comment.

directives.name: Level
directives.description: The level of the run, written as a word (Full) or as Level=Full. Without it the job's Level applies. Base and Since are accepted; the Onesimus Director then keeps the job's level.

directives.name: Pool override
directives.description: Pool=, FullPool=, IncrementalPool=, DifferentialPool= and NextPool= replace the pools of the job for this run.

directives.name: Other overrides
directives.description: Storage=, Messages=, Priority=, SpoolData=yes|no, Accurate=yes|no and MaxRunSchedTime= replace the job's settings for this run.

examples.config: Run = Incremental Priority=5 Storage=File2 mon-fri at 21:00

directives.name: Weekday
directives.description: mon ... sun (or monday ... sunday), single or as a range mon-fri; several separated by commas.

directives.name: Week of the month
directives.description: 1st ... 5th (or first ... fifth), ranges such as 2nd-5th; last means the last seven days of the month. Combined with a weekday: "1st sun".

directives.name: Day of the month
directives.description: Numbers 1 to 31, ranges such as 1-7, written with on: "on 1 at 01:05". n/m means every m-th day starting with day n (1/2: odd days).

directives.name: Month
directives.description: jan ... dec (or the full names), single, as list or range.

examples.config: Run = Full on 1 jan, jul at 02:00

directives.name: Week of the year
directives.description: w00 ... w53 (ISO weeks); wNN/wMM means every MM-th week starting with week NN.

directives.name: Daily, weekly, monthly, hourly
directives.description: daily (every day), weekly (on Sunday), monthly (the first of the month) and hourly (every hour, at the minute given by at).

directives.name: Time
directives.description: at HH:MM in 24-hour time (am/pm are accepted). Without at the run starts at 00:00 (hourly: at :00). Several times need several Run lines.
